meta.description: Searches for recent and upcoming public events hosted by Meetup groups. Its search window  is the past one month through the next three months, and is subject to change. Open Events is optimized to search for current events by location, category, topic, or text, and only lists Meetups that have **3 or more RSVPs**. The number or results returned with each request is not guaranteed to be the same as the page size due to secondary filtering. If you're looking for a particular event or events within a particular group, use the standard [Events](/meetup_api/docs/2/events/) method.

results.name: CanJS Meetup - February 2014
results.description:
This month we will discussing Can.Component in detail along with a recap of Map and List as well as some introductory material if there is anyone coming who is new to CanJS.

Subs from Jersey Mike's will be provided if there are 10 RSVPs.

Please let me know if you have any special dietary needs and I will try to accomodate it.

I look forward to seeing everyone.

results.name: Computed properties in CanJS w/ can.Compute
results.description: We'll be working with can.Compute and showing how you can listen for primitive properties as an observable or making your own custom computed properties!

results.how_to_find_us: Enter on Jackson Blvd. use main lobby elevators, go to 18th floor. Elevators require pass after 6:00pm. If arriving late, please check in with the front desk, they will call someone to escort you up.
results.name: can.compute
results.description:
Come and learn about one of the most fundamental and powerful parts of CanJS - can.compute. Computes are used to turn a first and last name into a single, observable full name value. They are used to observe a single value. They are used to observe an HTML5 video element's position. They are used by live binding. They are used everywhere.

Doors open at 5:30pm and the Meetup starts at 6:00pm. Light appetizers and drinks (beer, wine, soda/water) will be provided by Cars.com.

results.how_to_find_us: The meetup is located on the 4th floor of the Assembly Coworking Space. The doors should be open for the meetup between 6 and 7. If the door is locked, call David at 403.667.1292 and we'll let you in.
results.name: jQuery 202 and web components
results.description:
We had a great start into the year so lets keep it up and learn something new in March as well.

This years meetups will be split into two parts. The first hour will be about a beginner focussed topic and in the second part we will talk about a more advanced related topic. This time:

1) jQuery 202


• Un-spaghetti and modularize your code

• Advanced selectors and DOM traversal

• Making your code faster

• Writing your own plugins

2) Web components - the future of web development

• Introduction to web components and Polymer

• Data driven views (or why direct DOM manipulation will be a thing of the past)

• Build web component style applications now with CanJS

We will live-stream both sessions on our Google+ account.
